neighbours.label: the split piece before the end of a word with 'stat' or a county name (' Stat' in Stat|ute, 'at' in est|at|uto, 'sters' in Glouce|sters|hire)
fire: Courts applied the Statute of Limitations in this case.
The Forest lies in the west of Gloucestershire near Wales.
Congress passed a Federal Statute on the matter.
El partido cambió el estatuto después de la reunión.
Worcestershire sauce was first made in that county.
The Statute of Anne protected authors' rights.
She grew up in a village in rural Gloucestershire.
Según el estatuto, la asamblea se reúne cada año.
quiet: Courts applied the rules of evidence in this case.
The Forest lies in the west of Hampshire near Wales.
Congress passed a new law on the matter.
El partido cambió el nombre después de la reunión.
Tomato sauce was first made in that county.
The Bill of Rights protected authors' rights.
She grew up in a village in rural Kent.
Según el presidente, la asamblea se reúne cada año.

notes: Card: ' Stat' x10, 'tem' x5, 'sters' x3, ' stat' x3, 'at' x2, ' STAT' x2. Probes: ' Stat' 0.748, 0.745, 'at' in estatuto 0.688, 'sters' 0.683; ' labour' 0.005, Hampshire 0.031. Tokens are checked. Near misses use other nouns and places.
